title: A bench suite: plugins/tools/bench/suites/<suite>/suite.json
description: What the bench runs (plugins/docs/bench.md): an agent, headless, on each task's prompt in a throwaway sandbox, for each variant of the plugin's files, and the checks (the suite's checks.py) that score each run.

plugin.description: The plugin under test, a folder in plugins/plugins/.

project.description: The made-up project each run starts in, written into the sandbox's project folder and committed.

module.description: The module, relative to plugins/, that exports the project's files.

export.description: The module's export holding the files: path → text.

commit.description: The message of the project's one commit.

agent.description: The agent that runs the tasks.

model.description: The model, as omp's --model takes it.

thinking.description: The thinking level, as omp's --thinking takes it.

repeats.description: Runs per variant and task; --repeats overrides it.

concurrency.description: Runs at a time; --concurrency overrides it.

timeoutMinutes.description: A run still going after this long is stopped.

guide.description: The plugin-relative file whose reading the read checks look for.

variants.description: Versions of the plugin: name → files it replaces (plugin-relative path → file relative to the suite folder). {} is the plugin as checked out.

tasks.description: Task id → the prompt the agent gets and the checks (names in checks.py's CHECKS) that score its runs.

name.description: Lowercase words joined by -: suites, variants, tasks and checks.
